label:
<think>
The compilation errors stem from SpongeAPI 8 changes: ChannelRegistrar, RawDataListener, and ChannelBuf were removed/moved, and RawDataChannel was relocated. To fix:
- Update imports to the new packages: RawDataChannel in org.spongepowered.api.network.channel.raw, ChannelBuf in org.spongepowered.api.network.channel, and ChannelManager replaces ChannelRegistrar.
- Remove RawDataListener usage (interface removed), so drop implements and @Override.
- Adjust channel creation to use ChannelManager with a ResourceKey: channelManager.ofType(ResourceKey, RawDataChannel.class).
- ChannelBuf no longer exposes array(), so read bytes using readableBytes/readBytes.
- For sending, prefer writeBytes over writeByteArray for compatibility with the new ChannelBuf API.

These minimal edits should compile against SpongeAPI 8 while keeping functionality as intact as possible.
</think>
